path_policy: All artifact paths are POSIX-style, relative to the derivation package, contain no parent traversal, and name regular files when bound.

review_slots.staleness: This review binds Theory/06_general_coarsegraining.tex at 4891a8f5... and Theory/07b_agent_network_rg.tex at 5eb159493ec72721..., which are the add1a69 bytes. At the released revision 8ce6358 those files hash fa10620d2a1d0e51... and 268f9c3b75b09966..., and the 07b edit inserted thm:rg-pointwise-parent-datum itself. The review's own post-review-mutation falsification clause is therefore met. The APPROVE disposition applies to the pre-integration snapshot only and does not extend to the released revision. See POST-RELEASE-CORRECTIONS.md (C1).
review_slots.severity_count_convention: Counts are findings remaining against the CORRECTED bytes, after any finding raised during the review was repaired. A nonzero count is therefore unreachable by construction, and a 0/0/0 result records that the review-and-repair loop terminated -- it is not a measurement of how many defects the reviewed text originally contained. At least one real pre-fix mathematical error is recoverable from git for this package (raw t*log(t) called pointwise nonnegative, corrected to the generator phi_0). Disclosed by the 2026-08-16 remediation of finding L8; see POST-RELEASE-CORRECTIONS.md.

review_binding_rule: Reviews bind the corrected pre-review payload snapshot; final metadata binds current review hashes. Review agreement is adjudication and cannot replace direct mathematical evidence.

review_input_snapshot.purpose: Exact corrected mathematical and release-facing payload reviewed while target was CANDIDATE and terminal_status was null.

provenance_model.stage_1: Each domain review binds the corrected pre-review snapshot above.
provenance_model.stage_2: Final assembly, ledger, and release bind the resulting review hashes and therefore have distinct post-review metadata hashes.
provenance_model.non_circularity: No mutual raw-hash fixed point is claimed; evidence/release-provenance.json records the final one-way snapshot.

required_repairs: M1: refresh the notation report from the exact final design bytes and cascade its binding.
M2: add required artifact metadata to the deterministic witness output and the dynamics/scope review.
fix_round_1_review_input_snapshot.binding_rule: This is the immutable input snapshot examined by the post-commit Fix Round 1 reviewer; the repaired final-release snapshot is recorded one-way in evidence/release-provenance.json.

final_certification_evidence.attack_disposition_meaning: Quoting evidence/adversarial-attacks.md:4: "REJECTED means the attack does not defeat the recorded scoped claim because a cited derivation or counterexample supplies the needed condition. It does not mean the stronger shortcut is true." This count is NOT evidence that the theorem is true: 15 of the 16 attacks have a disposition fixed by a frozen premise or an explicit non-claim, so both branches of the counterfactual yield REJECTED. See POST-RELEASE-CORRECTIONS.md (H2).

final_release_snapshot_record.self_hash_rule: The record excludes its own SHA-256; its bytes are captured by Git and the ignored Task-5 report.

unresolved_obligations: Re-run VIEW-PROBABILITY-KERNEL and VIEW-GAUGE-HOLONOMY against 8ce6358 bytes and re-stamp (C1).
Repair or replace review_input_snapshot in evidence/release-provenance.json (H1).
release_gate.reason: All static ancestors have eligible direct evidence; reconstruction and oracle erasure pass. Two of the four domain reviews (VIEW-INFORMATION-VFE, VIEW-DYNAMICS-SCOPE) are current APPROVE records; the other two are BOUND_STALE_PRE_INTEGRATION against canonical sources edited after they approved. The sixteen-attack disposition is NOT cited as a ground for this gate, because a rejection count whose outcome is fixed by frozen premises carries no information about the theorem. See POST-RELEASE-CORRECTIONS.md.
